about_the_game:
Endless Puzzles, Timeless Beauty

Dive into the calming world of Shards Reunited: Kintsugi, a 2D jigsaw puzzle game where you piece together beautiful Japanese porcelain objects, one shard at a time. In this first chapter of the Shards Reunited series, immerse yourself in a serene experience as you restore vibrant porcelain treasures, each showcasing intricate Japanese designs like cherry blossoms, temples, and tranquil landscapes.

Gameplay

It’s simple yet satisfying: each level presents a new porcelain object broken into shards. Drag, rotate, and snap the pieces into place to complete the puzzle, then move on to the next. With puzzles ranging from easy to challenging, there’s always another piece to fit, offering endless hours of quiet focus and relaxation.

A Feast for the Eyes

Every porcelain object bursts with color, featuring hand-drawn Japanese designs in vivid hues—pink cherry blossoms, red-roofed temples, and misty blue mountains. Set against a minimalist backdrop with soothing music, the game creates a peaceful atmosphere perfect for unwinding.

Key Features

  • Puzzle After Puzzle: A continuous stream of jigsaw challenges, from simple to intricate, keeping you engaged.

  • Vibrant Porcelain Art: Enjoy colorful Japanese designs that bring each object to life.

  • Serene Atmosphere: Relax with calming music featuring traditional Japanese instruments like the koto.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Videocard with at least 512MB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: If you love puzzles and crave a straightforward, relaxing experience, Shards Reunited: Kintsugi is for you. There’s no fluff, just pure puzzle-solving joy with beautiful Japanese porcelain to keep your eyes delighted and your mind at ease.
